description: This file contains Redux action creators for managing order-related operations in a React/Redux e-commerce application, including fetching, searching, updating, and canceling orders.

methods.name: updateOrderStatus
methods.description: Creates an action to update the order status in the Redux store.

methods.name: setOrderLoading
methods.description: Creates an action to set the loading state for order operations.

methods.name: fetchOrders
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches a list of orders with pagination, updates Redux store, and handles loading state.

methods.name: fetchAccountOrders
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the current user's orders with pagination, updates Redux store, and handles loading state.

methods.name: searchOrders
methods.description: Performs a search for orders based on a filter and updates the store with results.

methods.name: fetchOrder
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific order by ID, with optional loading indicator.

methods.name: cancelOrder
methods.description: Cancels the current order and redirects to the orders dashboard.

methods.name: updateOrderItemStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an individual order item, handles order cancellation, and refreshes order data.

methods.name: addOrder
methods.description: Creates a new order from the cart and navigates to the success page.

methods.name: placeOrder
methods.description: Initiates the order placement process, including cart ID retrieval and order creation.

methods.name: clearOrders
methods.description: Clears the order list in the Redux store.
